verses.sloka: ततो निकुम्भो रभसः सूर्य शत्रुर् महाबलः ।सुप्तघ्नो यज्ञ कोपः च महापार्श्वो महाउअरः ॥६-९-१॥।।
verses.transliteration: tato nikumbho rabhasaḥ sūrya śatrur mahābalaḥ ।suptaghno yajña kopaḥ ca mahāpārśvo mahāuaraḥ ॥6-9-1॥।।

translations.english: Then Nikumbha, Rshabha, mighty Suryasatru, Supthagna, Yagnaha raksha, Mahaparva, Mahodaro, Durdarsha, Agnikethu, Rasmikethu Rakshasas, Further Ravana's own son powerful Indrajith, Virupaksha and Prahasta, and mighty Rakshasas Vajradamshtra, Dumraaksha and also Durmukha of huge body holding iron bars, tridents, battle axes, bows and sharp arrows, very sharp swords, got up, highly enraged and all Rakshasas glowing like fire addressed Ravana.
translations.hindi: कह युद्धकाण्ड आठवा सग पूरा हुआ सल ठेला वा० रा० यु००-७ नवमः संग; "घ्य 0९व्व्त्त् ततो निङुम्भो रभसः सर्यशजुमहाबलः । सुप्तप्षो यज्ञहा रक्षी महापाश्वों महोदरः

verses.sloka: अग्नि केतुः च दुर्धर्षो रश्मि केतुः च राक्षसः ।इन्द्रजिच् च महातेजा बलवान् रावण आत्मजः ॥६-९-२॥।।
verses.transliteration: agni ketuḥ ca durdharṣo raśmi ketuḥ ca rākṣasaḥ ।indrajic ca mahātejā balavān rāvaṇa ātmajaḥ ॥6-9-2॥।।

translations.english: Then Nikumbha, Rshabha, mighty Suryasatru, Supthagna, Yagnaha raksha, Mahaparva, Mahodaro, Durdarsha, Agnikethu, Rasmikethu Rakshasas, Further Ravana's own son powerful Indrajith, Virupaksha and Prahasta, and mighty Rakshasas Vajradamshtra, Dumraaksha and also Durmukha of huge body holding iron bars, tridents, battle axes, bows and sharp arrows, very sharp swords, got up, highly enraged and all Rakshasas glowing like fire addressed Ravana.

verses.sloka: प्रहस्तो अथ विरूप अक्षो वज्र दम्ष्ट्रो महाबलः ।धूम्र अक्षः च अतिकायः च दुर्मुखः चैव राक्षसः ॥६-९-३॥।।
verses.transliteration: prahasto atha virūpa akṣo vajra damṣṭro mahābalaḥ ।dhūmra akṣaḥ ca atikāyaḥ ca durmukhaḥ caiva rākṣasaḥ ॥6-9-3॥।।

translations.english: Then Nikumbha, Rshabha, mighty Suryasatru, Supthagna, Yagnaha raksha, Mahaparva, Mahodaro, Durdarsha, Agnikethu, Rasmikethu Rakshasas, Further Ravana's own son powerful Indrajith, Virupaksha and Prahasta, and mighty Rakshasas Vajradamshtra, Dumraaksha and also Durmukha of huge body holding iron bars, tridents, battle axes, bows and sharp arrows, very sharp swords, got up, highly enraged and all Rakshasas glowing like fire addressed Ravana.

verses.sloka: परिघान् पट्टसान् प्रासान् शक्ति शूल परश्वधान् ।चापानि च सबाणानि खड्गामः च विपुलान् शितान् ॥६-९-४॥।।
verses.transliteration: parighān paṭṭasān prāsān śakti śūla paraśvadhān ।cāpāni ca sabāṇāni khaḍgāmaḥ ca vipulān śitān ॥6-9-4॥।।

translations.english: Then Nikumbha, Rshabha, mighty Suryasatru, Supthagna, Yagnaha raksha, Mahaparva, Mahodaro, Durdarsha, Agnikethu, Rasmikethu Rakshasas, Further Ravana's own son powerful Indrajith, Virupaksha and Prahasta, and mighty Rakshasas Vajradamshtra, Dumraaksha and also Durmukha of huge body holding iron bars, tridents, battle axes, bows and sharp arrows, very sharp swords, got up, highly enraged and all Rakshasas glowing like fire addressed Ravana.
translations.hindi: ले लेकर और उठ उठ कर तथा क्रोध में भर और अगिन की तरह लाल हो, रावण से बोले

verses.sloka: प्रगृह्य परम क्रुद्धाः समुत्पत्य च राक्षसाः ।अब्रुवन् रावणम् सर्वे प्रदीप्ता इव तेजसा ॥६-९-५॥।।
verses.transliteration: pragṛhya parama kruddhāḥ samutpatya ca rākṣasāḥ ।abruvan rāvaṇam sarve pradīptā iva tejasā ॥6-9-5॥।।

translations.english: Then Nikumbha, Rshabha, mighty Suryasatru, Supthagna, Yagnaha raksha, Mahaparva, Mahodaro, Durdarsha, Agnikethu, Rasmikethu Rakshasas, Further Ravana's own son powerful Indrajith, Virupaksha and Prahasta, and mighty Rakshasas Vajradamshtra, Dumraaksha and also Durmukha of huge body holding iron bars, tridents, battle axes, bows and sharp arrows, very sharp swords, got up, highly enraged and all Rakshasas glowing like fire addressed Ravana.

verses.sloka: अद्य रामम् वधिष्यामः सुग्रीवम् च सलक्ष्मणम् ।कृपणम् च हनूमन्तम् लंका येन प्रधर्षिता ॥६-९-६॥।।
verses.transliteration: adya rāmam vadhiṣyāmaḥ sugrīvam ca salakṣmaṇam ।kṛpaṇam ca hanūmantam laṁkā yena pradharṣitā ॥6-9-6॥।।

translations.english: "Right now, we will kill Rama along with Lakshmana, Sugriva and vile Hanuman, on whose account Lanka was attacked."
translations.hindi: हम लेग आज ही राम, सुग्रीव, लक्ष्मण तथा उस बापुरे हनु-- मान को, जो यहाँ आकर लङ्का जला गया था--मार डालेंगे

verses.sloka: तान् गृहीत आयुधान् सर्वान् वारयित्वा विभीषणः ।अब्रवीत् प्रान्जलिर् वाक्यम् पुनः प्रत्युपवेश्य तान् ॥६-९-७॥।।
verses.transliteration: tān gṛhīta āyudhān sarvān vārayitvā vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।abravīt prānjalir vākyam punaḥ pratyupaveśya tān ॥6-9-7॥।।

translations.english: With folded hands, Vibheeshana made all the (Rakshasas) wielding arms to stop and sit and addressed these words to Ravana.
translations.hindi: उन आयुध लिए हुए समस्त राक्षसा को वरज कर ओर बैठा कर, विभीषण ने रावण से हाथ जोड़ कर विनती की

verses.sloka: अपि उपायैस् त्रिभिस् तात यो अर्थः प्राप्तुम् न शक्यते ।तस्य विक्रम कालाम्स् तान् युक्तान् आहुर् मनीषिणः ॥६-९-८॥।।
verses.transliteration: api upāyais tribhis tāta yo arthaḥ prāptum na śakyate ।tasya vikrama kālāms tān yuktān āhur manīṣiṇaḥ ॥6-9-8॥।।

translations.english: "Dear father, intelligent people say that an act which cannot be accomplished by the three means (Sama Conciliation, Dana Gift, Bheda Sowing dissension), should only be accomplished diligently by one's heroic deed. Therefore, we should think of war only after the above three means are employed."

verses.sloka: प्रमत्तेष्व् अभियुक्तेषु दैवेन प्रहतेषु च ।विक्रमास् तात सिध्यन्ति परीक्ष्य विधिना कृताः ॥६-९-९॥।।
verses.transliteration: pramatteṣv abhiyukteṣu daivena prahateṣu ca ।vikramās tāta sidhyanti parīkṣya vidhinā kṛtāḥ ॥6-9-9॥।।

translations.english: "O Dear at those who are not alert, who are attacked by the enemy, and who are struck by fate, if you examine diligently according to prescribed method and perform deeds of heroic valour you will succeed."

verses.sloka: अप्रमत्तम् कथम् तम् तु विजिगीषुम् बले स्थितम् ।जित रोषम् दुराधर्षम् प्रधर्षयितुम् इच्चथ ॥६-९-१०॥।।
verses.transliteration: apramattam katham tam tu vijigīṣum bale sthitam ।jita roṣam durādharṣam pradharṣayitum iccatha ॥6-9-10॥।।

translations.english: "How do you wish to overpower, him who is very attentive, bent on victory, mighty, steadfast, has subdued anger and unassailable?"
translations.hindi: oo — ६७ पाठान्तरे “प्रच्षरिता ।” ७७ टॅ यु क्र तुम लोग उन प्रमादरहित, जयेच्छ, देवसाहाय्य प्राप्त ( अथवा सेनिक बल से युक्‍त ) क्रोध को जीते हुए और अजेय रामचन्द्र को किस प्रकार जीतने की इच्छा करते हो ?

verses.sloka: समुद्रम् लन्घयित्वा तु घोरम् नद नदी पतिम् ।कृतम् हनुमता कर्म दुष्करम् तर्कयेत कः ॥६-९-११॥।।
verses.transliteration: samudram langhayitvā tu ghoram nada nadī patim ।kṛtam hanumatā karma duṣkaram tarkayeta kaḥ ॥6-9-11॥।।

translations.english: "Hanuman has crossed over the ocean, a Lord of streams and rivers and arrived. Who can ever know or think of such a task in this world?"

verses.sloka: बलानि अपरिमेयानि वीर्याणि च निशा चराः ।परेषाम् सहसा अवज्ञा न कर्तव्या कथम्चन ॥६-९-१२॥।।
verses.transliteration: balāni aparimeyāni vīryāṇi ca niśā carāḥ ।pareṣām sahasā avajñā na kartavyā kathamcana ॥6-9-12॥।।

translations.english: "Enemy's strength and valour is inestimable to relate. Do not disregard rashly, O Night ranger"
translations.hindi: हे निशाचरो ! शत्रु की पराक्रमी अगणित भयङ्कर सेना है--- सो ऐसे शत्रुओं की सहसा अवज्ञा करना कभी उचित नहीं

verses.sloka: किम् च राक्षस राजस्य रामेण अपकृतम् पुरा ।आजहार जन स्थानाद् यस्य भार्याम् यशस्विनः ॥६-९-१३॥।।
verses.transliteration: kim ca rākṣasa rājasya rāmeṇa apakṛtam purā ।ājahāra jana sthānād yasya bhāryām yaśasvinaḥ ॥6-9-13॥।।

translations.english: "What offence did Rama do earlier to the Rakshasa king that he abducted the glorious wife of Rama from Janasthana?"
translations.hindi: क्या पहिले किसी ने जान पाया था या किसी ने कल्पना भी की थी कि, हनुमान नदीपति भयङ्कर समुद्र को लाँघ, ( दो घड़ी में ) यहाँ चता आवेगा

verses.sloka: खरो यदि अतिवृत्तस् तु रामेण निहतो रणे ।अवश्यम् प्राणिनाम् प्राणा रक्षितव्या यथा बलम् ॥६-९-१४॥।।
verses.transliteration: kharo yadi ativṛttas tu rāmeṇa nihato raṇe ।avaśyam prāṇinām prāṇā rakṣitavyā yathā balam ॥6-9-14॥।।

translations.english: "(It is true) Khara was killed by Rama in war as he acted beyond his limit. Certainly, living beings will have to protect their life with their own strength."
translations.hindi: यदि राम ने खर को मारा तो क्या अनुचित किआ । क्योंकि वह्‌ इनका अपमान करना चाहता था । इसी से उन्होंने ऐसा किआ । क्योंकि प्रत्येक जीवधारी को अपने बलानुरूप अपनी प्राणरक्ता करनी ही चाहिए

verses.sloka: एतन् निमित्तम् वैदेही भयम् नः सुमहद् भवेत् ।आहृता सा परित्याज्या कलह अर्थे क्Rते न किम् ॥६-९-१५॥।।
verses.transliteration: etan nimittam vaidehī bhayam naḥ sumahad bhavet ।āhṛtā sā parityājyā kalaha arthe kRte na kim ॥6-9-15॥।।

translations.english: "On account of this, we have a great fear of Vaidehi. She, who was brought here, is to be given away. What is the use of doing anything, which may be the cause of strife?"
translations.hindi: दूसरे की खो को हर लेना केवल बढनामो का ही कारण नहीं है, बल्कि आयु को क्षीण करने बाजा सी है । ऐसा करने से धन का नाश होता है और फिर बड़ा भारी पाप सी लगता है

verses.sloka: न नः क्षमम् वीर्यवता तेन धर्म अनुवर्तिना ।वैरम् निरर्थकम् कर्तुम् दीयताम् अस्य मैथिली ॥६-९-१६॥।।
verses.transliteration: na naḥ kṣamam vīryavatā tena dharma anuvartinā ।vairam nirarthakam kartum dīyatām asya maithilī ॥6-9-16॥।।

translations.english: "To have enmity with a valorous one, a follower of dharma, is useless and not good for us. Give away Mythili to him (Rama)."
translations.hindi: क एतन्निमित्तं बैंदेही भयं न; सुमहङ्कवेत्‌ । यह हर कर लाई हुई सोता हम लोगों के लिए बड़े भय की है। सो हमें उचित है कि इसका परित्याग करे । व्यथ लड़ाई झगड़ा करने से लाभ ही क्या है

verses.sloka: यावन् सगजाम् साश्वाम् बहु रत्न समाकुलाम् ।पुरीम् दारयते बाणैर् दीयताम् अस्य मैथिली ॥६-९-१७॥।।
verses.transliteration: yāvan sagajām sāśvām bahu ratna samākulām ।purīm dārayate bāṇair dīyatām asya maithilī ॥6-9-17॥।।

translations.english: "Before Rama comes with elephants and horses and tears with his arrows, this Lanka filled with abundance of gems, give away Mythili."
translations.hindi: श्रीरासचन्द्र जो बड़े पराक्रमी और धर्मात्मा हैं, अकारण उनके साथ वैर बाँबना अनावश्यक है। अतएव पहिले ही उनको सीता दे देनी चाहिए

verses.sloka: यावत् सुघोरा महती दुर्धर्षा हरि वाहिनी ।न अवस्कन्दति नो लंकाम् तावत् सीता प्रदीयताम् ॥६-९-१८॥।।
verses.transliteration: yāvat sughorā mahatī durdharṣā hari vāhinī ।na avaskandati no laṁkām tāvat sītā pradīyatām ॥6-9-18॥।।

translations.english: "Lest the highly dreadful, formidable and huge Vanara troops surround all over Lanka. Give away Sita."

verses.sloka: विनश्येद्द् हि पुरी लंका शूराः सर्वे च आक्षसाः ।रामस्य दयिता पत्नी न स्वयम् यदि दीयते ॥६-९-१९॥।।
verses.transliteration: vinaśyedd hi purī laṁkā śūrāḥ sarve ca ākṣasāḥ ।rāmasya dayitā patnī na svayam yadi dīyate ॥6-9-19॥।।

translations.english: "If Rama's dear wife is not given, this Lanka will be destroyed and also all Rakshasas."
translations.hindi: घोड़ों, हाथियों तथा बहुत से रत्नों से भरी पूरी इस लङ्का को रामचन्द्र अपने बाणा से नष्ट भ्रष्ट करे, इसके इस ही, उनको सीता दे देनी चाहिए ॥ द 3 यावस्सुधोरा महती दुर्थर्षा हरिवाहिनी । नावस्कस्दति नो लङ्कां तावत्सीता प्रदीयताम्‌

verses.sloka: प्रसादये त्वाम् बन्धुत्वात् कुरुष्व वचनम् मम ।हितम् पथ्यम् त्व् अहम् ब्रूमि दीयताम् अस्य मैथिली ॥६-९-२०॥।।
verses.transliteration: prasādaye tvām bandhutvāt kuruṣva vacanam mama ।hitam pathyam tv aham brūmi dīyatām asya maithilī ॥6-9-20॥।।

translations.english: "I am requesting you because you are my relation (brother). Do as I said, as I am telling you for your welfare. Give away Sita."

verses.sloka: पुरा शरत् सूर्य मरीच्चि सम्निभान् ।नव अग्र पुन्खान् सुदृढान् नृप आत्मजः ।।।
verses.transliteration: purā śarat sūrya marīcci samnibhān ।nava agra punkhān sudṛḍhān nṛpa ātmajaḥ ।।।

translations.english: "You may restore Rama's Mythili, before the emperor Dasaratha's son sends forth solid unfailing arrows shining like autumnal Sun provided with fresh heads and shafts for killing you."
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌ ! ) तुम मेरे भाई हो, इसी से में तुमको मना रहा हूँ और तुमसे हितकर तथा यथाथ बातें कहता हूँ कि, तुम सीता को अवश्य लौटा दो

verses.sloka: सृजति अमोघान् विशिखान् वधाय ते ।प्रदीयताम् दाशरथाय मैथिली ॥६-९-२१॥।।
verses.transliteration: sṛjati amoghān viśikhān vadhāya te ।pradīyatām dāśarathāya maithilī ॥6-9-21॥।।

translations.english: "You may restore Rama's Mythili, before the emperor Dasaratha's son sends forth solid unfailing arrows shining like autumnal Sun provided with fresh heads and shafts for killing you."
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌ ! ) तुम मेरे भाई हो, इसी से में तुमको मना रहा हूँ और तुमसे हितकर तथा यथाथ बातें कहता हूँ कि, तुम सीता को अवश्य लौटा दो

verses.sloka: प्रसीद जीवेम सपुत्र बान्धवाः ।प्रदीयताम् दाशरथाय मैथिली ॥६-९-२२॥।।
verses.transliteration: prasīda jīvema saputra bāndhavāḥ ।pradīyatām dāśarathāya maithilī ॥6-9-22॥।।

translations.english: "Give up that happiness and anger which destroys virtues. Seek pleasures that enhance fame. Be pacified. Live happily with sons and relatives restoring Mythili to Rama, the son of Dasaratha."
translations.hindi: हे महाराज ! राजकुमार श्रीरामचन्द्र जी जब तक तुम्हारे वध के लिए, सूय की किरणों की तरह चमचमाते पङ्क लगे हुए बड़े मजबूत और अमोघ बाण नहीं छोड़ते, उसके पूव ही तुम उन्हें सीता दे दो

verses.sloka: त्यजस्व कोपम् सुख धर्म नाशनम् ।भजस्व धर्मम् रति कीर्ति वर्धनम् ।।।
verses.transliteration: tyajasva kopam sukha dharma nāśanam ।bhajasva dharmam rati kīrti vardhanam ।।।

translations.english: Having heard everything that was told by Vibheeshana, the Lord of Rakshasas sent away all and entered his palace. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेनवमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the ninth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

verses.sloka: विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।विसर्जयित्वा तान् सर्वान् प्रैवेश स्वकम् गृहम् ॥६-९-२३॥
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।visarjayitvā tān sarvān praiveśa svakam gṛham ॥6-9-23॥
